q: What makes up the carbon footprint of dry pet food?
title: Pet food carbon footprint
short: Ingredients dominate, especially meat and fish meals and grains. The factory adds steam for extrusion and gas or electricity for drying. Ask ingredient suppliers for figures per kg, then add your fuel, power and packaging per kg of finished kibble.
audience: Pet food makers and private label brands
senseible: Senseible reads your electricity bills, fuel invoices and purchase invoices into dated, fingerprinted records, so a per unit footprint can be traced back to the documents behind it. Estimates are labelled as estimates.

sources.label: GHG Protocol Corporate Value Chain (Scope 3) Standard
